title: SYS SWAPFILES · DUPLEX · TCPXFER/TCPLISTEN — bidirectional any-payload host flow
summary: Host-plane bidirectional flow for arbitrary string/bag data: plate content swap (SWAPFILES), mailbox RTT write-out/read-in (DUPLEX/BIDXFER), and CBXF-framed TCP peer send+recv (TCPXFER/TCPLISTEN). Complements SMX EXCHANGE which is matrix-bit only.
